hook_line: Price sits at support 0.7200 while VWAP sits 5% higher, testing the lower Bollinger band.

scenarios.bull_if: price holds above 0.7200 support and rebounds toward 0.7267 resistance
scenarios.bear_if: price breaks below 0.7200 support and falls toward 0.715 SL

smc_logic: Higher‑timeframe uptrend aligns with a bullish HH‑HL structure, but 1H EMA20 sits above price, creating a pull‑back zone at the 0.7200 support. A bounce here would respect the bullish structure; a break would flip bias. VWAP and Bollinger bands highlight the price’s proximity to the lower volatility envelope.
smc_logic_short: Mark support 0.7200, resistance 0.7267, VWAP 0.7560, lower BB 0.7124.
technical_analysis: HH‑HL bullish continuation on 1H, mixed 4H; price near lower Bollinger, EMA20/50 above, RSI 37 indicating oversold pressure.
indicators_summary: EMA20 0.7256 > price, EMA50 0.7379 > price, RSI 37 (below 40), MACD -0.0015 vs signal -0.0025 (narrow negative), VWAP 0.7560 above price, BB lower 0.7124, position 0.33, Stoch RSI 0/0 flat.
